title: Signature manifest
description: The integrity and signature file of a package (master plan 4.5 check 1, 9.1), at signatures/signature-manifest.json. Generated by the signing tool, not authored. It has two parts. 'signed' is the integrity manifest: every file of the package except those under signatures/ (a fixed rule: the signature material cannot cover itself), with its SHA-256 and size, sorted by path. 'signatures' holds detached Ed25519 signatures over the canonical JSON of 'signed' (UTF-8, object keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace; the payload contains only strings and integers, so this is also the RFC 8785 form). A file found in the package but absent from signed.files, or present with another digest, is tampering and fails the package; a package with no valid, unexpired signature by a key registered for the application is unsigned and cannot leave quarantine. The signature is verified before anything else in the package is trusted. JSON, not YAML: it is machine-written and is hashed byte-for-byte as part of the canonical payload.

format.description: The file format and its major version.

signed.description: The signed payload. Every byte of it is covered by every signature.

signatures.description: Detached signatures over the canonical JSON of signed. At least one. Several allow a key rotation overlap; a package verifies if at least one signature is valid, unexpired, by an unrevoked key registered for application_id and listed in the manifest's integrity.publisher_key_ids.

application_id.description: The application the package is for. Must equal the manifest's application.id; it binds the signature to one application so a package cannot be replayed for another.

package_version.description: The package version the signature covers. Must equal the manifest's package.version.

created_at.description: When the integrity manifest was generated.

hash_algorithm.description: The digest algorithm of the files list. Must equal the manifest's integrity.hash_algorithm.

files.description: Every file of the package outside signatures/, sorted ascending by path (byte order), one entry per path (the loader rejects duplicates and unsorted lists). At least one: alixai.yaml itself is always listed.

path.description: The package-relative path. Portable and traversal-free by grammar; nothing under signatures/ is ever listed. Symbolic links are refused by the signing tool and have no entry.

key_id.description: The ID of the publisher key that made the signature, as registered in the trust store for the application.

algorithm.description: The signature algorithm. Only ed25519 exists; the verifier accepts exactly this one.

signature.description: The 64-byte Ed25519 signature in standard base64 with padding (88 characters).

expires_at.description: When the signature stops being valid. Required: a signature never lasts forever, and an expired one fails closed. Must be later than signed_at.
